trace.question: For the patients with an abnormal Ig M level, what is the most common disease they are diagnosed with?
trace.evidence: abnormal Ig M level refers to IGM <=40 OR IGM >= 400; most common disease refers to MAX(COUNT(Diagnosis));

attempts.sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGM <= 40 OR l.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGM <= 40 OR l.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The most common diagnosis among patients with an abnormal IgM level is SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus).
